en.text: At the end of twenty years, in which Solomon had built the LORD’s house and his own house,

zhSimplified.text: 所罗门建造耶和华殿和王宫，二十年才完毕了。

zhTraditional.text: 所羅門建造耶和華殿和王宮，二十年才完畢了。

en.text: Solomon built the cities which Huram had given to Solomon, and caused the children of Israel to dwell there.

zhSimplified.text: 以后所罗门重新修筑希兰送给他的那些城邑，使以色列人住在那里。

zhTraditional.text: 以後所羅門重新修築希蘭送給他的那些城邑，使以色列人住在那裏。

en.text: Solomon went to Hamath Zobah, and prevailed against it.

zhSimplified.text: 所罗门往哈马琐巴去，攻取了那地方。

zhTraditional.text: 所羅門往哈馬瑣巴去，攻取了那地方。

en.text: He built Tadmor in the wilderness, and all the storage cities, which he built in Hamath.

zhSimplified.text: 所罗门建造旷野里的达莫，又建造哈马所有的积货城，

zhTraditional.text: 所羅門建造曠野裏的達莫，又建造哈馬所有的積貨城，

en.text: Also he built Beth Horon the upper and Beth Horon the lower, fortified cities with walls, gates, and bars;

zhSimplified.text: 又建造上伯·和 、下伯·和 作为保障，都有墙，有门，有闩；

zhTraditional.text: 又建造上伯‧和崙、下伯‧和崙作為保障，都有牆，有門，有閂；

en.text: and Baalath, and all the storage cities that Solomon had, and all the cities for his chariots, the cities for his horsemen, and all that Solomon desired to build for his pleasure in Jerusalem, in Lebanon, and in all the land of his dominion.

zhSimplified.text: 又建造巴拉和所有的积货城，并屯车辆马兵的城，与耶路撒冷、黎巴嫩，以及自己治理的全国中所愿意建造的。

zhTraditional.text: 又建造巴拉和所有的積貨城，並屯車輛馬兵的城，與耶路撒冷、黎巴嫩，以及自己治理的全國中所願意建造的。

en.text: As for all the people who were left of the Hittites, the Amorites, the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites, who were not of Israel—

zhSimplified.text: 至于国中所剩下不属以色列人的赫人、亚摩利人、比利洗人、希未人、耶布斯人，

zhTraditional.text: 至於國中所剩下不屬以色列人的赫人、亞摩利人、比利洗人、希未人、耶布斯人，

en.text: of their children who were left after them in the land, whom the children of Israel didn’t consume—of them Solomon conscripted forced labor to this day.

zhSimplified.text: 就是以色列人未曾灭绝的，所罗门挑取他们的后裔作服苦的奴仆，直到今日。

zhTraditional.text: 就是以色列人未曾滅絕的，所羅門挑取他們的後裔作服苦的奴僕，直到今日。

en.text: But of the children of Israel, Solomon made no servants for his work, but they were men of war, chief of his captains, and rulers of his chariots and of his horsemen.

zhSimplified.text: 惟有以色列人，所罗门不使他们当奴仆做工，乃是作他的战士、军长的统领、车兵长、马兵长。

zhTraditional.text: 惟有以色列人，所羅門不使他們當奴僕做工，乃是作他的戰士、軍長的統領、車兵長、馬兵長。

en.text: These were the chief officers of King Solomon, even two-hundred fifty, who ruled over the people.

zhSimplified.text: 所罗门王有二百五十督工的，监管工人。

zhTraditional.text: 所羅門王有二百五十督工的，監管工人。

en.text: Solomon brought up Pharaoh’s daughter out of David’s city to the house that he had built for her; for he said, “My wife shall not dwell in the house of David king of Israel, because the places where the LORD’s ark has come are holy.”

zhSimplified.text: 所罗门将法老的女儿带出大卫城，上到为她建造的宫里；因所罗门说：「耶和华约柜所到之处都为圣地，所以我的妻不可住在以色列王大卫的宫里。」

zhTraditional.text: 所羅門將法老的女兒帶出大衛城，上到為她建造的宮裏；因所羅門說：「耶和華約櫃所到之處都為聖地，所以我的妻不可住在以色列王大衛的宮裏。」

en.text: Then Solomon offered burnt offerings to the LORD on the LORD’s altar which he had built before the porch,

zhSimplified.text: 所罗门在耶和华的坛上，就是在廊子前他所筑的坛上，与耶和华献燔祭；

zhTraditional.text: 所羅門在耶和華的壇上，就是在廊子前他所築的壇上，與耶和華獻燔祭；

en.text: even as the duty of every day required, offering according to the commandment of Moses on the Sabbaths, on the new moons, and on the set feasts, three times per year, during the feast of unleavened bread, during the feast of weeks, and during the feast of booths.

zhSimplified.text: 又遵着摩西的吩咐在安息日、月朔，并一年三节，就是除酵节、七七节、住棚节，献每日所当献的祭。

zhTraditional.text: 又遵着摩西的吩咐在安息日、月朔，並一年三節，就是除酵節、七七節、住棚節，獻每日所當獻的祭。

en.text: He appointed, according to the ordinance of David his father, the divisions of the priests to their service, and the Levites to their offices, to praise and to minister before the priests, as the duty of every day required, the doorkeepers also by their divisions at every gate, for David the man of God had so commanded.

zhSimplified.text: 所罗门照着他父大卫所定的例，派定祭司的班次，使他们各供己事，又使利未人各尽其职，赞美耶和华，在祭司面前做每日所当做的；又派守门的按着班次看守各门，因为神人大卫是这样吩咐的。

zhTraditional.text: 所羅門照着他父大衛所定的例，派定祭司的班次，使他們各供己事，又使利未人各盡其職，讚美耶和華，在祭司面前做每日所當做的；又派守門的按着班次看守各門，因為神人大衛是這樣吩咐的。

en.text: They didn’t depart from the commandment of the king to the priests and Levites concerning any matter or concerning the treasures.

zhSimplified.text: 王所吩咐众祭司和利未人的，无论是管府库或办别的事，他们都不违背。

zhTraditional.text: 王所吩咐眾祭司和利未人的，無論是管府庫或辦別的事，他們都不違背。

en.text: Now all the work of Solomon was accomplished from the day of the foundation of the LORD’s house until it was finished. So the LORD’s house was completed.

zhSimplified.text: 所罗门建造耶和华的殿，从立根基直到成功的日子，工料俱备。这样，耶和华的殿全然完毕。

zhTraditional.text: 所羅門建造耶和華的殿，從立根基直到成功的日子，工料俱備。這樣，耶和華的殿全然完畢。

en.text: Then Solomon went to Ezion Geber and to Eloth, on the seashore in the land of Edom.

zhSimplified.text: 那时，所罗门往以东地靠海的以旬·迦别和以禄去。

zhTraditional.text: 那時，所羅門往以東地靠海的以旬‧迦別和以祿去。

en.text: Huram sent him ships and servants who had knowledge of the sea by the hands of his servants; and they came with the servants of Solomon to Ophir, and brought from there four hundred fifty talents of gold, and brought them to King Solomon.

footnotes.text: 8:18 A talent is about 30 kilograms or 66 pounds or 965 Troy ounces, so 450 talents is about 13.5 metric tons

zhSimplified.text: 希兰差遣他的臣仆，将船只和熟悉泛海的仆人送到所罗门那里。他们同着所罗门的仆人到了俄斐，得了四百五十他连得金子，运到所罗门王那里。

zhTraditional.text: 希蘭差遣他的臣僕，將船隻和熟悉泛海的僕人送到所羅門那裏。他們同着所羅門的僕人到了俄斐，得了四百五十他連得金子，運到所羅門王那裏。
